scope: Three H01 entry negative regression modules, four own named cases, against current root-applied owner/fixture; no production change
apply: After root releases source freeze, review then copy each .py.unapplied to tests/product/ with the same basename minus .unapplied. No helper or production edits are proposed.
All fixtures imported as module aliases; no imported TestCase global and no subclass of existing fixture TestCase. Each module contains at most two own test methods.
Root owns all test execution. Draft creation performed only static source reads and ART writes; no imports/compile/tests/DB/process/native/Git/provider/network execution.

cases.recipe: Actual immutable registered strategy unchanged; dataclasses.replace actual canonical four E1 candles with flat close/open60000 and valid high60001/low59999, retain actual times/received_at/source identities; build_asof_bundle normal recorded model; first invoke real StrategyRuntime and require NO_TRADE/NO_RULE_MATCHED.
cases.assertions: Actual runner status NO_TRADE; durable exact actual E2 signal; effects[]; no TradeIntent/ExitRequest/operation; no pending canonical publication; actual canonical objects empty, no plan/order/fill/position/TR, no dispatch operation or provider calls; retry after actual fixture clock+1s is identical saved decision/outcome.

cases.recipe: Keep actual original E2 LONG/intent, selected owner canonical risk JSON and original sizing proposal; explicitly replace only RiskContext.available_balance with Decimal1. Independently call unchanged actual evaluate_trade_intent at original now and require REJECT containing INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.
cases.assertions: Actual runner API status BLOCKED/reasons equal actual E5; exact original E2 outputs and one RISK_DECISION effect; actual canonical object table contains exactly that RiskDecision/payload, no plan/order/fill/position/TR, no dispatch operations/provider calls. Retry+1s preserves exact immutable decision, risk payload/hash/id and canonical persisted_at.

cases.recipe: One actual fixture; four subcases: future boundary+1h with cutoff now; future cutoff+1s with boundary now; historical_close_assumption; dataclasses.replace SelectedRiskPolicy.risk_policy with valid max_margin+1 while canonicalJSON/hash are unchanged.
cases.assertions: Exact existing ProductDispatchError codes: ENTRY_OPERATIONAL_ASOF_CLOCK_REQUIRED for all three asof failures, ENTRY_CALLER_POLICY_OWNER_MISMATCH for forged typed policy; no entry decision/publication, canonical object, dispatch operation or provider call.

cases.recipe: Actual flat E1 NO_TRADE proved by real E2; normal first immutable decision; same boundary/candles/policy/proposal with only explicit available_balance100->99.
cases.assertions: Existing ENTRY_BOUNDARY_INPUT_CONFLICT, exact original decision retained; original-input retry still same NO_TRADE/outcome; no financial effects/canonical object/dispatch/provider calls.

source_contract_notes: Actual EntryEvaluationOutcome statuses are NO_TRADE for actual E2 abstention and BLOCKED for actual E5 REJECT; evidence.status remains REJECT. Draft uses these exact current names.
Actual robust subject delegates GT(close,trend) and LT(close,trend), so flat canonical closes yield neither rule. No authored strategy/immutable registered source is replaced.

PaperRuntimeJournal.recover requires lineage and resolves RiskDecision through an existing ApprovedTradePlan. Therefore REJECT orphan risk is asserted by a future read-only SELECT from actual journal._store._connection; recover(original fixture planid) is used only for absence of downstream plan/orders/fills/position/TR.
All SQL in drafts is SELECT-only and would execute solely under root-run tests in temporary fixture stores. No SQL or DB open was performed while preparing these artifacts.

Fixture initially creates an independent E4 oracle request and provider response script, but neither is dispatched/stored by these negatives. The actual service translator/provider are never substituted or patched.
No effects spy returns a risk/signal/PASS value; no SQL terminal/status writes, policy authority fabrication, LIVE execution, PaperZero funding or financial defaults.
limitations: NOT_EXECUTED: syntax/import/test behavior unverified; root must run actual cases after source freeze.

These cases do not exercise APPROVE PREPARED/no-local-preparation recovery, publication prefix failures, source-content/candle mutation conflicts, native timing or original E2 exit management. Existing corrected positive separately covers one-claim expired/revoked direct reconciliation.
Source hashes identify the exact static base inspected. Reconcile future root changes before application; no automatic coverage or acceptance status follows from the draft.
